title: AI tools enable a surge in custom music gear firmware
excerpt: Sophisticated coding tools are driving a wave of custom firmware for hardware synthesizers, samplers, and grooveboxes.
body_html:
A growing trend of custom firmware is emerging across hardware synthesizers, samplers, and grooveboxes. Online communities and video platforms have highlighted this rapid growth in modified software for electronic music equipment.

These custom firmware projects are largely driven by increasingly advanced vibe-coding tools. Previously, developing custom software modifications for such hardware was an extremely rare occurrence.
